variants.headline: Assembly votes down government bill
variants.body: A government bill has been voted down in the Colonial Assembly. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: A proposal meets its parliamentary limit

variants.headline: Government legislation fails the vote
variants.body: A proposed government bill has failed in the Assembly vote. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.
